title: Deploy Zero Hour Checklist
content:
Purpose: personal zero-hour scratchpad for the 2026-03-11 production cutover. This is my working checklist — informal, expect gaps. Use official runbook as source-of-truth but keep this for quick checks and reminders.

Timeline (local TZ):
- T-120m: final pre-cutover sync with oncall + infra lead (quick sanity).
- T-60m: lock PRs, set maintenance message if needed, snapshot config.
- T-30m: confirm DB migration dry-run completed, broadcast go/no-go poll in #releases.
- T-10m: scale up canary pool, enable traffic shadowing.
- T-0 (zero-hour): flip routing, disable legacy routetables, verify canary success.
- T+10m: smoke checks, latency baseline, sanity dashboards.
- T+60m: full traffic, monitor error budgets, start postmortem notes if needed.

Quick preflight checklist (my short version):
- [ ] Verify commit pinned in deployment config (serving-runtime:v2026.02.24-584).
- [ ] Confirm SRE/infra oncall paged and acknowledged (Marco).
- [ ] DB migration already applied on staging + backup taken: snapshot id __ (confirm).
- [ ] TLS certs valid for prod endpoint (expiry > 90d).
- [ ] Rate limit config check: token bucket sizes + quotas match proposal.
- [ ] Ensure dedicated capacity pool has spare GPUs for rollback window.
- [ ] Secrets/keys: KMS rotations not scheduled during cutover.

Commands to run (copy-paste from memory, validate before executing):
- kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/serving-runtime --timeout=10m
- gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="name~'prod-db-backup'" --limit=5
- curl -sS https://prod-api.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
- gh pr view 584 --repo redwood-inference/serving-runtime --json state,mergeable
- splunk query: search index=prod_errors earliest=-15m | stats count by status_code

Canary and rollback criteria (short):
- Canary is green if: 95th latency <= baseline+50ms for 10m AND error rate < 0.1% over 10m window.
- If error rate spikes > 1% or 95th latency > baseline+200ms for 5m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK to previous tag.
- Manual rollback triggers: failing health-checks in >2 regions OR major customer-reported outages.
- Rollback steps (rapid):
  1) kubectl set image deploy/serving-runtime serving-runtime=<previous-tag> -n prod
  2) scale down new canaries, propagate previous version to regions
  3) notify #releases + post incident channel with rollback reason + logs snippet

Communications (short templates):
- Pre-cutover (T-30): "Taking scheduled production cutover for release REL-2026 in ~30m. Expect brief change in routing and short increased error budgets during canary. Oncall: @MarcoLi, @JReyes."
- If rollback: "Rollback performed for REL-2026 at T+6m due to elevated error rates. Rolling back to serving-runtime:<previous-tag>. Postmortem in progress. Pager duty team notified."
- Post-success: "Cutover complete. REL-2026 serving-runtime rollout reached 100% at T+52m. Monitoring for regressions for next 2 hours. Thanks @oncall-team."

Monitoring quick checks (my fast list):
- Dashboards:
  - tokens/sec by region (expect smooth increase)
  - 95th latency per model (watch spiky models: long-context ones)
  - errors by component (router, kv-cache, gRPC backend)
  - GPU utilization per pool (no OOM or abnormally low utilization)
- Logs: tail router logs for new 500/502 patterns; search for "kv-cache miss" spikes.
- Alerts to watch: P50 latency alert, error-rate-surge, autoscaler-failure.

Backports/patches to consider (if time allows pre-T-30):
- cherry-pick PR #591 (fix for retry loop under high qps) — small, low-risk but validate in canary.
- backport config change for metrics exporter (PR #579) into v2026.02.x branch.
- Note: if backport lands, re-run small integration test in staging and re-tag artifact.

Edge cases & gotchas (notes to self):
- If traffic pattern shows huge prefix cache misses, revert kv-cache config only after confirming hit/miss ratio with telemetry team.
- Watch for ripple effect from DB migration: read replicas may lag and cause increased 5xx.
- Cloud provider maintenance windows: double-check no maintenance within T+24h for affected zones.

Post-deploy quick retro (fill in live):
- What went well:
  -
- What surprised me:
  -
- Action items (owners & due dates):
  -

Open questions / TODOs (personal):
- Should we include a pre-cutover smoke test that hits long-context models specifically? (ask Jordyn)
- Confirm whether Dedicated pool autoscaler will honor canary min size; I saw a race on last deploy.
- Add a small script to diff config before/after cutover (generated diff emailed to #releases).

Random scratch bits:
- Remember to mute non-essential alerts during final 15m ramp (but keep paging ones).
- Bring laptop charger. Seriously.
- If everything looks green at T+60m, schedule 30m to update runbook with any deviations.

End of scratchpad — merge important items into formal runbook after cutover.
